user.description: Corrects misheard artist, album, song and playlist names in "play ..." voice commands by matching them against your Music Assistant library. Change the language, thresholds and replies afterwards under Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Music Match is already set up.

init.description: Replies are Home Assistant templates. They can use these variables: heard (the name as the voice assistant heard it), name, artist (songs and albums only), media_type and area.

data_description.language: Requests in this language are matched. Music Match passes requests in other languages to Home Assistant's own handler.
data_description.act_threshold: A match scoring at least this much plays straight away. Scores run from 0 to 1.
data_description.ask_threshold: A match between this and the play threshold asks the did-you-mean question first. Lower scores go to Music Assistant's search unchanged.
data_description.reply_playing: Spoken after the matched item starts playing.
data_description.reply_not_found: Spoken first when Music Match is unsure. The question follows once the voice assistant has finished speaking.
data_description.reply_did_you_mean: Asked when Music Match is unsure. On a voice assistant, a yes answer plays the item.
data_description.answers_yes: Phrases that count as yes to the question.
data_description.answers_no: Phrases that count as no to the question.

error.ask_above_act: The ask threshold must not be higher than the play threshold.
